description: Correct a quantity-tracked item's stock at ONE location — "we used up 12 batteries", "50 arrived", "recounted: there are 7". Pass EXACTLY ONE of delta (relative: negative = used up, positive = received) or setTo (absolute recount). kind states the intent (usage | receipt | correction; inferred from the argument shape when omitted); reason is a short note for the activity timeline. Negative deltas past the location's unreserved stock are rejected (the error names the amounts) — a setTo recount always records reality, even below reservations. A restock task opens automatically when a location's AVAILABLE stock — on hand minus what is reserved for active orders — drops below its threshold, so a location can be low even with a full shelf. The result echoes every stocked level as distribution: { locationId, name, kind: location|person, quantity, available, reserved?, minStock?, isLow? } — the SAME row shape check_item_availability returns — so isLow tells you straight away whether this adjustment pushed the location under its threshold, without a second read. State a one-sentence summary and get your user's OK BEFORE calling. NOT for: moving stock between locations (transfer_stock), serialized items (assign_item / set_item_status). Requires the manager role. Not idempotent: a retried delta applies twice — after a timeout, check the returned numbers instead of retrying blindly.

delta.description: Relative change: negative = used up, positive = received (exactly one of delta/setTo)

itemId.description: Item id (must be a quantity-tracked item)

kind.description: Intent for the activity timeline; inferred from the argument shape when omitted

locationId.description: Location (or stock-holding person) resource id — find with search_resources or check_item_availability's distribution

reason.description: Short reason, shown in the item's activity timeline

setTo.description: Absolute recount — the new quantity at this location

name: adjust_stock

distribution.description: Every stocked level after the change — the SAME row shape check_item_availability returns

available.description: Freely usable stock: quantity minus reserved, floored at 0. Always present — this is the number to act on

isLow.description: True when available < minStock. Present only alongside minStock — absent means no threshold is set here, NOT that the level is healthy

locationId.description: Resource id of this place — pass it straight to adjust_stock, set_min_stock or transfer_stock (no search_resources round-trip needed)

locationName.description: DEPRECATED — the same string as `name`, kept only for clients whose tool list froze before the rename. Read `name`

minStock.description: Restock threshold here (absent when none is set)

reserved.description: Of that, promised to active orders (absent when 0)

newLevelQuantity.description: The adjusted location's stock after the change

title: Adjust stock
